name: Ooya Sakura
source:
She is the landlord of "Sakura Heights", the apartment where Jouji moved in. She is beautiful and very feminine. Her family name is written exactly the same as the word for landlord.

She has a strong sex drive and masturbates to porn almost every night. She also loves to do laundry.
